body: Integration-owner rule (Opus2, 2026-11-14 09:06Z, my own miss). When I GO a Central run meant to EARN a registered record (a closure check, a current-root check, any `--input commit` credit run), the GO must name the FOREGROUND form explicitly: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- <cmd>`, run as the owner's own foreground command with cwd = the named root (Claude: one Bash call `pushd "DIR" && ...`), with NO --detach and NO --notify. It must also forbid item writes (notes, status) between registration and END. Incident: d50d's W70 warm check test-438e8f8d used `--detach --notify session-8111`; the host replied "--detach is not a foreground focused check; no Test or Build record will follow", and d50d also wrote a START status note after registration. That ONE authorized run could earn nothing, and a corrected run needed a coordinator decision.
